goal: VC-201-087 (P1) claims mastery of: Exercise task identity, status, cancellation, artifact ownership, and retry semantics through supported adapters; duplicate deliveries and unknown remote outcomes cannot silently produce duplicate authoritative completion.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: A2A wire dialect selection, security schemes and extensions are documented with provenance. Verified by `crates/susi-gawd-a2a/src/a2a_profile.rs` (eco_a2a_versions_client_selects_dialect, eco_a2a_versions_fixture_documents_0_2_and_0_3, eco_a2a_security_documents_schemes_and_extensions) and `crates/susi-gawd-a2a/src/eco_a2a_security.rs` (profiles_are_valid, facts_cover_the_required_surface. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_087_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence. Closing this task records the outcome, not a passing test: write .agents/roadmap-verdicts/<the vector>.json with verdict 'delivered' (and the test or record that proves it) or 'not-delivered' (with what is missing and the task ids that track the follow-up work), then run scripts/check-roadmap-verdict.py <the vector> — which is this task's acceptance. A refutation therefore closes the task and files the work, instead of stalling on a test that cannot pass; the roadmap and the queue both understand the record. Do not reserve .agents/roadmap-verdicts in your claim: the directory is exempt from the scope check precisely so a verdict commits under your source claim, and reserving it would overlap every other verification task and serialize them all. Reserve the source paths you will touch, and add a scope if the verdict needs to change the vector's narrative in .agents/roadmap.json. Evidence must name something real: a path that exists in the checkout, or an identifier (a test name) that appears in it. The checker verifies this, so a verdict cannot be closed by typing a claim.
